title: AI Creative Director
intro: Your selected planner prepares the brief; your selected executor writes. The author decides what to keep.
modelPolicy: Uses existing AI settings. Providers never switch automatically.
max_calls: Maximum model calls for this task
budgetPolicy: A conservative local estimate requires configured prices and a supported output limit. Codex cost is unknown. This is not a provider bill.
approveContext: Review and approve this writing context before opening the director
important: I approve the important plot decisions
importantStep: This step requires author approval of a plot decision
reviewPolicy: Uses the existing literary reviewer. Covers the candidate and approved safe context, not all Canon. Reports are never forwarded automatically to Writer.
interveneHelp: Pause affects later scheduling. Stop cancels the current request and retains received text. Save new requirements, then explicitly continue.
instructionExample: Keep the first two paragraphs, then continue as a calm negotiation.
cancelCost: Stopping confirms local request handling. Upstream token charges may already exist. Requests are not retried automatically.
discardLocal: Discard unsaved local inputs? Saved tasks and background requests will remain.
cancelWaiting: Still waiting for the request to end. Local inputs remain available; save again later.
stopBeforeRewrite: Stop the current request before selecting a passage to rewrite.
selectDraft: Select a passage in the candidate draft and enter a new instruction.
saveBeforeContinue: Save edited drafts and requirements before continuing.
newStepInstruction: Continue the scene through concrete consequences of character choices.
briefHelp: Available after saving. Reads the approved safe context without a model call.
actualRequirements: Requirements delivered to the writing model
instructionBoundary: Use the current step; add an explicit condition in the brief if needed.
insufficientInputs: Partial input or not applicable to this step
noStyleEvidence: No confirmed profile supplied. Follow author intent and nearby prose without inventing a style profile.
briefPrivacy: Only approved Writer-view requirements are shown, without hidden reasoning or author secrets.
deferredOutcomes: Outcomes left for later (one per line)
pastReviewHelp: These sentences lack exact support in this input. They may be valid. Use the existing targeted review to investigate.
pastReviewNotError: These are low-certainty pointers, not factual verdicts or automatic edits.
localParameters: Saved with this task, separately for planning and writing; global preferences stay unchanged. Recheck supported parameters after changing a model.
externalChange: This record changed in another window or task. Your local edits remain; copy them before reopening the latest record.
savedLocal: Task draft and parameters saved locally; no manuscript adoption.
noHistory: No matching task. Enter a goal to prepare a local task draft.
elapsedBoundary: Time observed in this panel, not writing time or an estimate of time remaining
unsavedLocal: Local changes are unsaved. Save before executing or handing off.
candidateOnly: This console produces candidates. Adopt through the existing guarded Diff.
startHere: Start with a clear writing goal
startGoal: Enter a goal and choose Quick, Director or Deep mode.
startModels: Choose concrete models, supported effort and context budgets separately.
startConfirm: Prepare a local task, inspect the brief, then explicitly execute.
exported: Report exported. It includes the goal and candidate prose; check privacy before sharing.
handoffPrivacy: Python receives only your selected frozen candidate. Loading does not run code, call AI or read other tasks; other Actions retain their existing permissions.
completedPlan: All enabled steps are complete. Inspect the candidate/receipts, rewrite a selected passage, or edit and save further steps before continuing.
selectedStepBoundary: A single step appends to the candidate. It never runs other steps or rearranges existing prose.
customStepModel: Use independent model controls for this step
stepModelBoundary: Affects only this step. Review supported parameters and context budget after changing models. Inheritance does not change global settings.
forkBoundary: Copy this plan and model settings while retaining the original. Creating a copy is local only; execution still checks the manuscript revision and Writer approval.
forkContinueBoundary: Continue from current progress; completed steps are not automatically repeated.
forkFreshBoundary: Start the new attempt with an empty candidate and pending steps. The original remains available.
forkCreated: Independent attempt created locally. No model called; the original is retained.
analysisBoundary: Read-only analysis and actual output for author inspection. Never automatically sent to Writer context; not proof of literary or factual correctness.
analysisEmpty: No returned analysis. Hand a fixed candidate to Python, run it, then explicitly save the analysis record.
analysisStale: This analysis refers to an older candidate. Retain it as history; analyze the current version again.
analysisTruncated: Only the first 8,000 characters are shown here. Full output remains in the original Python run.
analysisRemoved: Task note removed. Original Python history retained.
noEnabledSteps: All steps are disabled. Enable or add a step and save before running; no model will be called now.

deliveryUI.length_NOT_SET: No length target for this task
deliveryUI.notStaged: Not yet saved as a Diff candidate
deliveryUI.completionBoundary: Model completion, finished steps, length targets, author acceptance and literary quality are separate outcomes. Counts use actual retained prose.
deliveryUI.shortComplete: The current steps ended, but the length target remains unmet.
deliveryUI.adjustScenes: Add scenes or revise a selection
deliveryUI.safeRetry: The Director will not restart a failed task or switch models automatically. Review retained text and remaining limits before continuing.
deliveryUI.runtime: Codex runtime used for this request
deliveryUI.runtimeBoundary: SDK paired package version; explicit overrides are labeled. The execution receipt identifies the actual observed model.
deliveryUI.tools: Budget preflight and book delivery check
deliveryUI.toolsBoundary: Local checks only; no model call. Book delivery uses current manuscripts or explicitly selected candidates, without changing statistics or confirmed settings.
deliveryUI.saveFirst: Save edits and wait for the current request to finish before checking a fixed version.
deliveryUI.estimateBoundary: The next step checks its actual application input; later steps use a character-cap upper estimate, not exact model tokens or promised output. Network, login and account balance are not tested. Submission still checks permissions and credentials. Required sources and limits remain unchanged.
deliveryUI.budget_READY: Current input passes the application budget check
deliveryUI.budget_POSSIBLE_BUDGET_RISK: Possible budget risk as text grows
deliveryUI.bookTitle: Book delivery check (separate from writing statistics)
deliveryUI.book_DRAFT_TARGET_REACHED: Draft length target reached; author review remains required
deliveryUI.bookBoundary: Each chapter counts either its current manuscript or the author-selected full candidate version, never both. Candidates are not accepted text. Length does not prove literary quality or a finished book.
deliveryUI.reason: Author reason for changing the target
deliveryUI.saveTarget: Confirm target change and retain previous version
deliveryUI.selectCurrent: Count current Diff candidate in delivery check
deliveryUI.emptyBook: No chapters to check. Create chapters through existing chapter management first.
deliveryUI.goalBoundary: A generation target, not an automatic rewrite or literary approval criterion. Shortfalls remain visible.
deliveryUI.sceneBoundary: Describe only the useful scene intent. This does not impose a fixed story formula or write to Canon.
deliveryUI.error_TIMEOUT: Request timed out; received text retained
deliveryUI.confirmBudget: The final pre-restart request duration is unknown. Review and save task limits before continuing. Limits are never increased automatically.
deliveryUI.book_NEEDS_FORMAT_REVIEW: Candidate heading placement needs author review
deliveryUI.formatWarning: This legacy candidate inserts prose before the chapter heading. Inspect the Diff and save a corrected full-chapter candidate. Nothing was changed automatically.
deliveryUI.scene_entry_state: Entry state: time, place, people and known facts
deliveryUI.scene_exit_state: Exit state required for the next passage
deliveryUI.duplicateBoundary: Exact-text pointers only. Repetition may be intentional; this is not a literary verdict and nothing is deleted automatically.
deliveryUI.staleCandidate: Director draft changed; save a new Diff candidate for this version
deliveryUI.staleReview: The existing review describes the earlier candidate, for historical comparison only. Review the new version separately.
deliveryUI.adoptedOtherVariant: The author accepted an edited Diff version; this draft was not overwritten
deliveryUI.preflightStale: The task, draft or controls changed. The old preflight is not valid for this version. Run the check again.
deliveryUI.bookSnapshot: This is the last manually checked snapshot. Reload the book delivery check after manuscript or candidate changes.
deliveryUI.targetSaved: The submitted book target is saved.
deliveryUI.targetSavedNewer: The submitted target is saved. Your newer target or reason is still unsaved and remains in the form.
deliveryUI.choiceSaved: Delivery candidate selection updated. Manuscript adoption still requires separate review.
deliveryUI.targetKept: Check refreshed. Your unsaved target and reason remain in the form; review before saving explicitly.
deliveryUI.pendingClose: A delivery update is awaiting its save receipt. Please wait before closing; you can continue editing the target fields.
deliveryUI.targetDiscarded: Unsubmitted target edits and reason discarded; the last checked saved target is retained.

takeoverRetained: Generation has stopped. Unsaved local text and directions are retained. Review and save them; nothing has been adopted into the manuscript.
takeoverReady: The retained candidate is ready for manual writing. Saving keeps it proposed and does not adopt it into the manuscript.
takeoverHelp: Takeover stops the current generation and opens candidate editing. Unsaved local input is retained instead of being replaced by the server draft.
reviewLoadFailed: The report is unavailable; the candidate was not changed. An unfinished review may not have produced a report. Retry reading or inspect the error details.
reviewHistorical: Historical report: the candidate or its authoring basis has changed. Retained for reference, not a review of the current version.
reviewReadOnly: Only attempts to read an existing project report. No model call or new review charge.
recordReadFailed: The latest task state could not be read. The last known result is retained until a valid update arrives; the task is not rerun.
reviewCandidateMatch: The report matches the saved candidate fingerprint. This is not approval of the manuscript.
reviewUnverified: This report cannot be verified against the current candidate: version evidence is missing or the report cannot be read. Check it before treating it as a current review.
reviewMultipleLocations: This quote occurs more than once; the first accurately displayable verified location is selected.
reviewNoVerifiedEvidence: No verified source quotation is available for this finding; treat it as an opinion for author review.
reviewSourcesChanged: The manuscript or referenced sources used by this report have changed. A matching candidate fingerprint does not establish current sources; recheck them and the review scope.
selectionChanged: The displayed candidate or selection changed. Save or refresh it, then select again.
